Specification: This module specifies a small library of operators for reading and writing CSV (Comma Separated Values) files from TLA+. The operators are intended to be overridden by Java implementations when executed by TLC. In the TLA+ specification itself, CSVWrite, CSVWriteRecord, and CSVRead all evaluate to TRUE, while CSVRecords returns an arbitrary natural number via CHOOSE n : n \in Nat.
